project.name: CropVision AI
project.tagline: A Mobile Crop Disease Detection System Using Image Validation and Severity Estimation
project.description: An offline mobile framework that checks photographs for blur and leaf content, identifies crop and disease via MobileViT (5.8 MB INT8), and estimates quantitative G0–G3 damage severity.

mainVideo.title: CropVision AI Full Application Walkthrough
mainVideo.description: Recorded screen walkthrough of CropVision AI on device: leaf photography, automated focus/quality checks, MobileViT disease classification, and severity-calibrated prescriptions.

grid.title: Full App Demo
grid.description: Complete walkthrough of the mobile app from leaf scanning to severity diagnosis.

grid.title: How to Use the App (Step by Step)
grid.description: Step-by-step tutorial: leaf positioning, reading diagnostic severity badges, and scheduling spray reminders.

grid.title: Model Training and Results
grid.description: Deep-dive into MobileViT-Small training on 54,306 images with 99.05% test set accuracy.

grid.title: Code Walkthrough
grid.description: Architecture tour: Flutter Provider state, Flask local inference server, and Supabase SQL schema.

fiveStepsGuide.title: Open CropVision AI
fiveStepsGuide.desc: Launch the app and tap 'Diagnose Crop Leaf' or select an active crop cultivar from the dashboard.

fiveStepsGuide.title: Position Leaf in Frame
fiveStepsGuide.desc: Center the suspected leaf inside the camera reticle with adequate ambient natural daylight.

fiveStepsGuide.title: Automated Quality Check
fiveStepsGuide.desc: On-device algorithms verify focus sharpness (>100 Laplacian score) and foliage content (>15% plant pixels) instantly.

fiveStepsGuide.title: Review Disease & Severity
fiveStepsGuide.desc: View the identified disease condition, confidence percentage, and quantitative G0–G3 severity grade.

fiveStepsGuide.title: Follow Tailored Prescriptions
fiveStepsGuide.desc: Apply calibrated chemical and biological treatments, follow spray intervals, and track recovery in history.
